## 2. Their witnesses (January): where the case is decided

### Salvador Osum dela Fuente: decides Q3

| What he swears | S19: his father sent him "maningil at mangolekta ng mga bayad sa upa at ng mga partial payment para sa bilihan ng lupa." S16: Cesar dealt "sa mga nagrerenta." S14 to S15: around 1992, at Ben Llamanzares's house, they learned the Balanes had agreed to buy "ang lupain na kanilang nirerentahan" and "nakapag-down payment na po sila." S31: he never saw the Keeseys give authority; Cesar dealt with the Agcaoili law office. S32: no notice of revocation reached them. He identifies the receipts (Def. Exh. 5). |
|---|---|
| Feeds | **Art. 1898, "exceeding the scope"; Art. 1900, "as written."** Paragraph 7 names holders of Llamanzares contracts to sell and those who paid Llamanzares. He describes renters and payments to Cesar's side. **Art. 1910 / Art. 1409(7):** payments to the agent's side are not the principals' ratification. |
| In her form | Considering that the defendants' witness testified that he collected "bayad sa upa" and partial payments for his father, and that the receipts he identified (Exh. 5) were issued by the agent's side and none by Ben Llamanzares, the defendant Gloria H. Balane is not shown to be among the persons described in paragraph 7 of the Special Power of Attorney (Exh. E); the sale of 29 September 2016 exceeded the agent's written authority (Art. 1898). |
| The risk | S14 to S15 is the defence's whole class proof. It is what Llamanzares said, reported by Salvador: hearsay as to any 1980s purchase. [COUNSEL: object, or let it in and cross] The cross is three questions: no contract to sell from Llamanzares; no receipt from Llamanzares; the ₱3,000 down payment has no paper. Then the receipts: ₱602,750 receipted against a ₱250,000 price, and ₱219,000 after a deed that says "in hand paid." |

### Princess Balane Torralba: Q3, Q6, Q7

| What she swears | S7: "noong una ay nirerentahan lang ito ng aking magulang at di-kalaunan ay kanila na rin nabili." S8 to S9: she gave money "para sa subdivision survey upang ma-segregate ang bahaging binili niya." S11: "Sa buong panahon ng aking paninirahan doon, wala akong naranasang pagtutol mula sa sinuman." Answer p. 9: she will testify to "the absence of any notice of revocation or dispute." |
|---|---|
| Feeds | **Art. 1898** (renter first, buyer later, undated). **Art. 496**, "by agreement between the parties": the survey she paid for is dated 8 September 2020, more than three years after Cesar's death in June 2017 [VERIFY: PSA death certificate]. **Art. 528**, "from the moment facts exist": blotter entry 2763, 19 May 2020. |
| In her form | Considering that the defendant Princess B. Torralba stated on 19 May 2020, as entered in the blotter of Barangay San Roque (entry No. 2763), that there was a pending question on the land ("May usapin pa yan"), and that she paid for the subdivision survey conducted on 8 September 2020, the defendants' possession was not free of notice of a dispute from that date (Art. 528), and the segregation of the portion was not made by agreement of the co-owners (Art. 496). |
| The risk | The blotter entry is the Kings' report of her words ("diumano"). As an official entry it proves the report was made; for the truth of the words, ask her on cross first. If she admits it, the entry is not needed. [VERIFY: certified copy of page 43] |

### Jomil Torralba: Q6, Q9

| What he will say | Answer p. 9: his residence "whenever he is ashore from sea service," the family's occupancy, "the absence of any notice of dispute prior to the filing of the case," and "the limited and intermittent nature of any room rentals." |
|---|---|
| The record against it | Joint resolution of 28 Jul 2020: he denied the King complaint because he was "merely acting on instructions of the owner of the property in the person of Gloria Balane thru Nelly Juntilla." Resolution of 16 Sep 2020, mailed to the respondents 23 Sep 2020: ownership must be settled "in court proceedings." Crim. 20-6030: ₱180,000 cash bail returned "to the payor Jomil L. Torralba" (6 Jan 2021). Civil Case 8563: his and Juntilla's lawyer received the Bicol Post notices on 9 Jul 2021. |
| Feeds | **Art. 528** and **PD 1529 §51** (good faith must last to the operative act of 23 Nov 2021). **Art. 549**, fruits: his "room rentals" and Answer ¶27. |
| In her form | Considering that the defendant Jomil Torralba, in July 2020, answered a criminal complaint concerning the same property on the ground that he acted on the instructions of Gloria Balane through her attorney-in-fact, and was advised by the Provincial Prosecutor on 16 September 2020 that ownership must be resolved in a proper court, facts existed before the registration of 23 November 2021 showing that the defendants were not unaware that their right was disputed (Art. 528; PD 1529, Sec. 51). Considering further that rooms on the property were rented out after 2016 (Answer, ¶27), the defendants shall account for the fruits received (Art. 549). |
| The risk | Whether the agent's or the lawyer's notice binds Gloria is a point of law. [COUNSEL] Without it, the records still defeat "no notice of any dispute" from Jomil himself. |

### Engr. Erwin H. Balane: Q6, Q8

| What he swears | S7 to S8: "Wala po akong naging partisipasyon sa pagproseso ng bentahan … Wala rin po ako partisipasyon" in the deed, the tax declaration or the titling. S16: he requested the certified copies attached to their Answer and kept documents "bilang panganay na anak habang nasa labas ng bansa ang aming mga magulang." |
|---|---|
| The record | Real property tax clearance of 13 August 2021, issued "upon request ERWIN H. BALANE," in the Registry's transfer file. |
| Feeds | **Art. 528**: the household was processing the transfer in August 2021, after the October 2020 publication and the July 2021 receipt. **Arts. 449, 1678**: building records, if the Building Official's return shows none. [COUNSEL] |
| In her form | Considering that the real property tax clearance used for the transfer was issued on 13 August 2021 upon the request of the defendant Erwin H. Balane, the transfer was being processed by the defendants' household after the publication of the revocation in October 2020. |
| The risk | Keep to the clearance and the permits. Nothing about his office's conduct in other matters. |

### Gloria H. Balane: only if her affidavit is admitted; one line works without it

| Without her | Their verified Answer ¶44(h): "Gloria checked the SPA, the Registry of Deeds records, tax records, and other official records." A judicial admission. |
|---|---|
| If admitted | Rent "through the previous administrator Ben Llamanzares, his representative Manuel Violeta" (her purposes, ¶4); "si Atty. Elaine Belen po ang tumulong at nag-follow up sa mga dokumento para sa transfer" (S53); she never read the Bicol Post. |
| Feeds | **Art. 1898, "aware of the limits of the powers granted"**; Art. 1902 (she required and read the power); Art. 526 "aware." |
| In her form | Considering that the defendant avers that she checked the Special Power of Attorney before and during the processing of the transfer (Answer, ¶44[h]), and that paragraph 7 of that instrument limits the power to sell to holders of contracts to sell from Ben Llamanzares and to those who paid him, after prior consultation with the owners, she contracted with the agent aware of the limits of the powers granted by the principals (Art. 1898). |
| The risk | Atty. Belen's receipt of the 15 August 2019 revocation letter is a copy-furnished line only. Not argued without proof of receipt. |
